notes: Refined normalization logic to explicitly separate API filter behavior from status derivation to prevent misclassification.

change_log.value: Implement core logic to extract enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API response and normalize into defined categories (RECRUITING, ACTIVE, COMPLETED). Explicitly map source values such as RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED. Ensure API-level RECRUITING filters do not override true status values returned per trial. Missing or ambiguous statuses must default to UNKNOWN.
change_log.note: Clarifies separation between API filtering and true status normalization
